facts.rationale: Replaces the vague and misleading inline-physics description with the actual state transition and ordered data flow.
facts.value: Evaluates it_8027A09C on the item object. On true, resolves Item and itFireAttributes, passes the object and model to effect creation for 0x464 at scale 1.1f, calls it_80273454, copies attribute x4 into vertical velocity, requests motion state 1 with argument 2, installs effect hitlag callbacks, and sets xDD1_flag.b1. The local inline performs state entry, not an ongoing physics update.

facts.rationale: The inline transitions to state 1 rather than continuing state-0 physics.
facts.value: Runs Moltres motion state 0's shared appearance-physics helper and, when it reports completion, creates effect 0x464, resets velocity, initializes vertical velocity from special attribute x4, and enters motion state 1 with effect hitlag handling before setting xDD1_flag.b1.

evidence.why: Guard side effects and exact timer ordering.

facts.rationale: Corrects the false-path no-op claim and identifies the actual destination state while preserving the timer's test-before-decrement behavior.
facts.value: Every invocation evaluates the side-effecting it_8027A09C helper: it calls it_80272860 with shared appearance parameters, then returns true after restoring configured scale if the appearance timer is already nonpositive; otherwise it decrements that timer and returns false. A false result skips the local transition but is not a wholly inert update. On true, the callback creates effect 0x464 at scale 1.1f, resets velocity, loads vertical velocity from x4, requests motion state 1 with argument 2, installs effect hitlag callbacks, and sets xDD1_flag.b1.
